## Ccut for Windows

The first Windows build of Ccut: a free, open-source desktop video editor with CapCut-style effects, filters and beat-synced editing. It is built on [OpenCut](https://github.com/opencut-app/opencut-classic).

### Download

- **`Ccut Setup *.exe`**: the installer (you can choose the install folder).
- **`Ccut-*-win.zip`**: a portable copy. Unzip it and run `Ccut.exe`.

> [!WARNING]
> **This is a pre-release.** It is built automatically on GitHub's Windows servers and has not yet been tested on a real Windows PC. Please [open an issue](https://github.com/Msh4i/ccut/issues) if something doesn't work.

> [!NOTE]
> The app is **not code-signed**, so Windows SmartScreen may warn you the first time. Click **More info → Run anyway**.

### Requirements

- Windows 10 or 11, 64-bit
- A GPU with WebGPU support (most GPUs from the last several years)

Features that need a local model (Auto hits stem separation, smart cutout) download it the first time you use them.
